title: Adobe's AI text-to-3D world concept is a glimpse of where Firefly could go next
key_facts: The US Patent and Trademark Office published a batch of Adobe patent filings, noticed by Patentlyze
One describes creating navigable 3D worlds from text, e.g. 'a foggy Japanese garden at dusk'
An unspecified AI model would first build a spherical 2D panorama, then a second AI process would build 3D geometry
The user could move through the generated environment
Other filings cover new camera angles from one photo, matching materials across 3D models and 3D garment previews
Adobe's Substance 3D Modeler has no Firefly generative tools yet
A patent does not necessarily signal a development plan
quote_evidence: One of them describes a method for creating navigable 3D worlds from text descriptions.
A patent application doesn't necessarily signal a development intention.
why_it_matters_hint: Hints at where Adobe's Firefly AI tools might go, but only as a filing.
notes: Patent publication, not a product announcement.
